text.headline: Mean over 8-10 Hz and 1-2 mm tremor: ink error none 835 um, weighted 1000, pencil+AKF 694, Rev H+AKF as shipped 775, Rev H+AKF re-tuned 535, Rev H oracle 79; words read by the app 0.31 / 0.58 / 0.99 (none / Rev H re-tuned / oracle). At 4-6 Hz: none 803, Rev H re-tuned 841, oracle 40 um.
text.implication: The +-3 mm nose has the reach for 1-2 mm tremor; the tremor tracker, not the mechanism, limits the benefit, and it barely acts below about 6 Hz
text.weighted_headline: +60 g: ink error x1.20 at 8-10 Hz and x1.08 at 4-6 Hz vs the 12 g pen (1-2 mm); see et_sensitivity for the stiff-grip case
